description: A shell script containing helper functions for managing GCE master instances in Kubernetes, including creation, replication, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: create-master-instance
methods.description: Creates a master instance, optionally with a specified reserved IP address.

methods.name: replicate-master-instance
methods.description: Replicates an existing master instance, setting up necessary certificates and environment.

methods.name: run-gcloud-command
methods.description: Executes a gcloud SSH command with retries.

methods.name: create-master-instance-internal
methods.description: Creates the master instance with specified parameters, handling retries and configuration.

methods.name: get-metadata
methods.description: Retrieves instance metadata from Google Cloud.
